title: Service Offering or Service Instance has no support group
cardHint: A Service Offering or Service Instance has no Support group, so incidents on it reach nobody.

message.subject: No Support group
message.intro: These CIs have no Support group.
message.ask: Please raise the request {request:support-group-update}. If the group does not exist yet, there is a request to create it.

askByClass.service_offering: Please raise the request {request:modify-service-offering}. If the group does not exist yet, there is a request to create it.

message.why: Without an active Support group, incidents on these CIs are not assigned to a team.
